$comment: Core Web Vitals reference lockfile for the /product/porta-cabins route (L11 baseline). Written after T24.1 + P1 image loading + P2 investigation. Supersedes the missing cwv-lockfile-2026-07-16b.json. Future PRs touching this route diff against these values; block on: LCP +200ms, CLS >0.1, or Perf below the baseline.

measurement.build: next build (production) + next start -p 3310, image optimizer cache warm
measurement.throttling: Lighthouse default (mobile: simulated Slow 4G + 4x CPU; desktop: preset=desktop)

mobile.$comment: Mobile Perf varies 74-86 across runs (Lighthouse variance + machine contention). Below the 95 target.

notes.lcp_element: Default 20x10 hero (SSR, fetchpriority=high, ). LCP-discovery insight scores 1/1.
notes.mobile_lcp_breakdown: TTFB ~120ms + resource-load-delay ~11ms + resource-load-duration ~83ms + element-render-delay ~1072ms. The image loads optimally; the shortfall is element-render-delay = React hydration of the page DOM under 4x CPU throttle.
notes.p2_finding: Deferring the applications explorer's hydration entirely (ssr:false diagnostic) dropped render-delay only ~290ms (1072->782) and mobile stayed ~80 / LCP ~5s. The explorer is NOT the bottleneck. First Load JS is ~92% shared framework/main/_app/CSS (only 12.9kB is page code), so route-level code-splitting cannot materially reduce it.
notes.path_to_mobile_95: Requires deferring hydration of the whole below-fold + a lighter shared bundle: a lazy-hydration approach (new dependency, needs approval) and/or an _app/shared-chunk reduction effort that spans the whole site — outside a single-route image/code-split packet.
